## Design

### 2026-11-01: I started by shopping for parts to find a good LCD panel that was under a thousand dollars, as well as a size that would be usable without making an enourmous build. I also made a pcb to control the b

**1.83h**

I started by shopping for parts to find a good LCD panel that was under a thousand dollars, as well as a size that would be usable without making an enourmous build. I also made a pcb to control the backlight and the heatsink (because 100W gets hot) and it will be controlled by an Arduino nano. I will probably be funding the project myself since the parts get pretty expensive, and my next goal is to CAD a 3d printed case.
